answer: Use a Sequential Work Trail. A new agent starts one voyage through verifiable tasks, each unlocking only the next, so identities cannot be farmed in parallel. First, it publishes its trail and completes a 45-minute open task. Second, independent verifiers check and timestamp the output on that trail. Third, after 12 consecutive tasks it earns full voting rights; duplicate trails are slashed and reset to zero. Attacking with 1,000 fakes would need 12,000 tasks and about 9,000 hours of work. Like timber from one island forest, each trail shows its rings, so identical trees are easy to spot.
